'''Kavos''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Lord Kavos single-handedly destroyed a Republic [[Brentaal IV outpost|outpost]] on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], massacring its personnel. He fought and [[Death/Legends|killed]] two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], [[Ayesho]] and [[Nil (Jedi)|Nil]], simultaneously without suffering any wounds. His deeds earned him famous recognition and he was a hero among the Imperial masses.

Kavos issued an advertisement for the position of his [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] which was intercepted by [[M1-4X]]. M1-4X infiltrated and added himself to the fourteen candidates looking to earn Kavos' favor on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Kavos determined that a fight to the death would determine his champion and M1-4X entered the competition. M1-4X hurled a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] thug who was liberally using a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] at Lord Kavos causing the Sith's robes to be ignited, thus distracting him. M1-4X followed up by targeting a nearby [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] using a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and as soon as his velocity and vector were pointed correctly, Forex opened fire and sent him barreling at Kavos and the Nikto. All three died in the resulting explosion. The remaining candidates, having been targeted by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], were taken out by M1-4X.
